results.title: Home-plate umpire Manny Gonzalez (heat exhaustion) leaves game in Cincinnati
results.description: Home plate umpire Manny Gonzalez left Monday's game between the San Diego Padres and host Cincinnati Reds after four innings due to heat exhaustion and dehydration that caused elevated blood pressure and blurred vision.

results.title: Giants' Anthony Molina cools off Braves, earns win over former team
results.description: Rafael Devers hit his 30th home run, Osleivis Basabe ignited a four-run sixth inning with a solo shot of his own and the San Francisco Giants made the most of a one-day visit to Georgia with a 7-3 victory over the Atlanta Braves on Monday night in the makeup game for a rainout.

results.title: Alcaraz makes light work of US Open comeback with straight-sets win
results.description: Carlos Alcaraz passed the first test of his US Open comeback with a routine straight-sets win over Roman Safiullin. The Spaniard, back to defend his title after more than four months out with a wrist injury, won 6-4, 6-4, 6-4 on Arthur Ashe Stadium.

results.title: Cam Schlittler calls Red Sox announcer Will Flemming a clown
results.description: Cam Schlittler will not be so quick to forgive Will Flemming. The longtime Boston Red Sox radio announcer Flemming sparked backlash over the weekend with some controversial comments during a game against the rival New York Yankees.
